facts.fact: 校长亲口称 Phil 为「Miss Philomela Fen」，语气像在宣读学期成绩报告
facts.anchor: drawing out the words as though Phil was here to be given an end-of-term report

facts.fact: Phil 开校长玩笑说别指望她吻校长的戒指
facts.anchor: ‘As long as I’m not expected to kiss your ring,’ Phil said

facts.fact: 校长说简历只够换来面试，换不来格雷恩的职位
facts.anchor: your CV got you this interview, but it will hardly secure you a post here at Grayne’s

facts.fact: Phil 承认父亲把钱全输在赌博上，亏空比家里以往知道的还多
facts.anchor: He lost money gambling. More than we ever knew.

facts.fact: 父亲的投资路线：先dot-com，后Enron与WorldCom，再倒卖Beanie Babies期货
facts.anchor: First he was buying into dot-coms, then he had stock in companies like Enron and WorldCom

facts.fact: Phil 的妹妹叫 Cressida，母亲忙于社交与照料妹妹
facts.anchor: Mamma was busy with society matters, and with looking after Cressida – she’s my little sister

facts.fact: 父亲去非洲打大猎，被大象踩中躺进医院，母亲在他昏迷期间取得授权查账
facts.anchor: ‘Big game hunting,’ Phil said. ‘An elephant stood on him. Possibly several elephants.

facts.fact: 母亲接管账目后告诉 Phil，家里供不起她继续做独立学者
facts.anchor: the family can’t afford to support me as an independent scholar any longer

facts.fact: 格雷恩原有的拉丁文教师毫无预警地离职
facts.anchor: our current Latin teacher has, alas, left us quite without warning

facts.fact: 拉丁文在前三年为必修，之后为选修
facts.anchor: Latin is a required subject here for the first three years, then optional following that

facts.fact: 校长以「校规传统」四两拨千斤地挡回「为何拉丁文是必修」的追问
facts.anchor: ‘A school tradition,’ Miss Jagerson explained, in a tone of voice clearly intended to close the subject

facts.fact: 校长要 Phil 试讲的对象是正在学《剑桥拉丁文教程》中段的二年级女生
facts.anchor: they’re in the middle of the Cambridge Latin Course

facts.fact: 校长当场宣布要 Phil 上一节试讲课
facts.anchor: I’d like to see you take a class of the girls for a sample lesson
